## <span class="span_generic">About the PI</span>

![](img/sasani_headshot_rxrx.png){style="float:right;padding: 0 0px 0px 0px;border-radius:90%" width="200"}

**Tom Sasani** (he/him) is an incoming Assistant Professor in the Department of Genetics at the University of Georgia.

Tom received a B.A. from Lawrence University in Appleton, WI and a Ph.D in Human Genetics from the University of Utah under the supervision of [Aaron Quinlan](http://quinlanlab.org/). He did postdoctoral work with [Kelley Harris](https://sites.google.com/site/harriskelley/home) at the University of Washington, and was a Senior Data Scientist at [Recursion Pharmaceuticals](https://www.recursion.com/) until 2022. Currently (until 2027), he is a research scientist in Aaron Quinlan's group.

## <span class="span_generic">Hiring</span>

Starting in January 2027, we will be actively recruiting graduate students, postdoctoral fellows, and research technicians!
Prospective graduate students should apply through the [Integrated Life Science (ILS)](https://ils.uga.edu/) program.
If you are interested in joining the lab, please reach out to Tom at `thomas [dot] a [dot] sasani [at] gmail [dot] com`.
